## 1 · Intake & safety
Webhook protected by **Header Auth** (`X-BookLeaf-Secret`, stored as an n8n credential).
Payload validated, then **deduplicated**: a second request for the same author within 120 s is rejected (Bubble also blocks double clicks).

## 2 · Facts → AI
All money/date maths happens in code (next payout = quarter end + 45 days, ₹1,000 rollover, 90-day overdue rule).
Gemini writes the prose from those facts with a JSON schema; on any failure (overload, rate limit, 20 s timeout) it switches straight to a **fallback model**, keeping the whole run well inside Bubble's request timeout. Output is checked (name + exact pending total) before sending.

## 3 · Deliver & report back
Email sent via the Gmail API (OAuth, no password stored) (redirected to a test inbox; intended recipient noted).
Every path answers the webhook with `{ status: Success | Failed, … }`, which Bubble writes into the Notification Log.
